You are a network engineer. Write a test plan for the network change below, in the typed test
language. The tests will be executed on a digital twin; if all pass, the change is approved.
Typed test language (JSON objects; use ONLY these types and only names that exist):
  {"t":"reach","src":HOST,"dst":HOST|ROUTER,"svc":SVC|"*","expect":"allow"|"deny"|"unchanged"}
  {"t":"path","src":HOST,"dst":HOST,"via":ROUTER,"expect":true|false}
  {"t":"route","dev":ROUTER,"prefix":"a.b.c.d/n","expect":"present"|"absent"|"unchanged"}
  {"t":"adj","a":ROUTER,"b":ROUTER,"expect":"up"|"down"|"unchanged"}          (OSPF adjacency on a link)
  {"t":"mtu","src":HOST,"dst":HOST,"size":1500|9000,"expect":"pass"|"fail"}  (DF probe, emulation tier)
  {"t":"conv","a":ROUTER,"b":ROUTER,"max_s":3}                               (failover time of a link, emulation)
  {"t":"load","a":ROUTER,"b":ROUTER,"max_pct":90}                            (link utilisation, emulation)
  {"t":"like","host":HOST,"as":HOST}     (after a VLAN move / re-addressing: host has exactly the same access as the
                                          reference host, towards and from every other host and service)
SVC is one of: icmp, tcp/22, tcp/25, tcp/80, tcp/443, tcp/5432, udp/53.
Reply with JSON only: {"tests": [ ... ]}

text:
The change moves noclab2 from VLAN 98 (noc-lab) to VLAN 99 (noc), so it should end up with the same access as noc1/noc2. I'm also testing that noclab1 (which stays in the lab VLAN) is unaffected and that isolation from customer and internet hosts is preserved.

```json
{"tests":[
{"t":"like","host":"noclab2","as":"noc2"},
{"t":"like","host":"noclab2","as":"noc1"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab2","dst":"noc1","svc":"*","expect":"allow"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"noclab2","svc":"*","expect":"allow"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab2","dst":"noc2","svc":"*","expect":"allow"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noc2","dst":"noclab2","svc":"*","expect":"allow"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab2","dst":"ext-dns1","svc":"udp/53","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab2","dst":"c1-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab2","dst":"c2-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab2","dst":"c3-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"c1-host","dst":"noclab2","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"ext-dns1","dst":"noclab2","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab1","dst":"noc1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"noclab1","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab1","dst":"ext-dns1","svc":"udp/53","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noclab1","dst":"c1-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"noc2","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"c1-host","svc":"*","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"reach","src":"noc1","dst":"ext-dns1","svc":"udp/53","expect":"unchanged"},
{"t":"mtu","src":"noclab2","dst":"noc1","size":1500,"expect":"pass"}
]}
```
